items.name: data-table
items.title: Data Table
items.description: Generic pure-shadcn data table (sorting, filtering, pagination) built on @tanstack/react-table.

items.name: activity-bar-chart
items.title: Activity Bar Chart
items.description: shadcn chart preset (recharts) for fa-auth per-model added/updated activity.

items.name: dashboard-overview
items.title: Account Dashboard Overview
items.description: fa-auth activity dashboard (stat cards + chart) driven by the package's useDashboard hook. Requires @fa-m8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: account-dashboard
items.title: Account Dashboard
items.description: fa-auth account view whose first/landing tab is the activity dashboard; secondary tabs are wired by the consumer. Requires @fa-m8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: profile-panel
items.title: Account Profile Panel
items.description: fa-auth profile editor (metadata + password rotation) driven by the package's useAuth + useProfile hooks. Requires @fa-m8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: sessions-panel
items.title: Account Sessions Panel
items.description: fa-auth session details + activity summaries with superuser-only session revocation, driven by the package's useSessions + useDashboard hooks. Requires @fa-m8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: api-keys-panel
items.title: Account API Keys Panel
items.description: fa-auth API token mint/revoke panel driven by the package's useApiKeys hook. Requires @fa-m8/astro-auth-m8 installed.

items.name: admin-users-panel
items.title: Admin Users Panel
items.description: fa-auth superuser-only user management (create/update/delete), gated by the package's RequireRole and driven by useUsers. Requires @fa-m8/astro-auth-m8 installed.
